title: SAT Reading and Writing Pilot — Illustrative Practice
description: Original, unofficial examples covering all four SAT Reading and Writing domains; not a full-length test.

questions.text: A field team recorded fewer bird calls on a windy morning than on a calm morning. The team notes that wind may have obscured calls. Which conclusion is best supported?
options: Wind may affect how many calls the team detects
Birds stop calling whenever wind rises
The site has no birds in windy weather
questions.correctAnswer: Wind may affect how many calls the team detects
questions.explanation: The passage says wind may have obscured calls, so detection could differ.

questions.text: In the sentence 'The editor tempered the claim after reviewing the small sample,' what does 'tempered' most nearly mean?
questions.explanation: The small sample led the editor to moderate the claim.

questions.text: The first trial produced promising results. _____, the researchers plan to repeat it with more participants.
questions.explanation: The transition signals a qualification: promising early results still need replication.

questions.text: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
options: The exhibit opened in May, it quickly attracted visitors.
The exhibit opened in May; it quickly attracted visitors.
The exhibit opened in May it, quickly attracted visitors.
questions.correctAnswer: The exhibit opened in May; it quickly attracted visitors.
questions.explanation: A semicolon correctly joins two independent clauses.
